title: Platinum Rewards Card: Maximizing Your Premium Benefits and Rewards
summary: This document explains how to maximize the Platinum Rewards Card: earn 10.0% on all categories on everyday purchases, use 0% foreign transaction fees for international spending, and qualify for a $150 annual fee rebate by meeting a $7,500 monthly spend threshold. It also covers smart redemption (redeem at $15+), and purchase protection for eligible items (keep receipts for up to 135 days; up to $17,500 per claim, subject to terms/exclusions).
